title: A lane brief takes every session id from the one roster, so a hand-typed wrong id cannot reach a lane
why: The coordinator's brief to lane reinstall-from-stable-allow named runner 10 with a wrong session id (session_013NEJL2gw6EdrSyvHkTUEx6; right one session_013NEJL2f1YCYsvLdpFqtWP3). Other briefs may carry it. Incident 01:22 CST Nov 14 (lane brief-ids-from-roster via the coordinator 01:19, relayed; #3352 re-handed to runner 10 at head 1eaf8440267d, lint PASS, round 1 PASS): a builder agent hand-typed a wrong session id into a commit trailer; the lane caught it and amended before the push. The new check covers briefs only, not commit trailers. Triage call: a note, not a debt. Rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes: a note becomes a debt after a real incident; triage counts this one as a near miss (caught before any push, no wrong link landed), so it stays a note, and the next wrong id is the real incident. Count: 1 near miss. Guard that would have stopped it: a check that a Claude-Session trailer id equals the session id in the attribution reminder; not queued; queue it as a step on the next wrong id. STATE 15:00 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:07, for the owner's 14:58 question; triage read none of the PR state): #3352 (lane session_013NEJKzfF8ADFGPK5pb7EdJ) is draft, head 1eaf8440267d, dirty, lane lint only, no review record. The lane was told at 15:03 CST to merge main and hand in to runner 10; it is not in runner 10's order yet.
source: Coordinator 20:47 CST Nov 13 (its own miss; relayed to triage).
note: Triage 20:48 CST Nov 13: guard named by the coordinator: a brief template that takes ids from one roster file; not built. The roster is the Standing sessions list in the roadmap CLAUDE.md, which the brief template already fills from (step role-ids-in-brief, done). Open: the miss was a hand-typed id, so the fix is a check that every session id in a brief appears in the roster, red case first. Unchecked: whether decision R22 (briefs name roles, never ids) bears on this; whether other briefs carry the wrong id. Coordinator 20:56 CST Nov 13 (20:56): lane started, session_013NEJKzfF8ADFGPK5pb7EdJ (Sonnet, medium); alone via runner 10; tracker the coordinator. Owner 00:19 CST Nov 14, item 819 b (ruling own-819-b-slug-or-role): a brief names a slug or role only, never a session id; change the PR #3352 check and docs/decisions/brief-ids-in-roster.md to match. The roster header is already rewritten.
